newsitem.title: USA: White House promises "credible" budget plan.
newsitem.headline: White House promises "credible" budget plan.

text.p: President Clinton scheduled a meeting with his economic advisers as his first order of second term business on Tuesday, and the White House said he would issue "marching orders" on achieving a balanced budget.

"I expect him to reiterate his determination to balance the budget ... He's prepared a real, credible, common ground budget that can reach bipartisan agreement quickly if Congress is so inclined," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.
Clinton is due to send his budget for the fiscal year starting next Oct 1 to Congress on Feb. 6.

"We want this budget to be treated seriously when it arrives on the Hill. We believe Congress when they look at the details of this budget will see that we've made a good-faith effort to write a credible, sensible balancd budget for the future," McCurry said.
The White House official said Clinton was optimistic that his budget would receive a fair hearing based on his soundings with Republican congressional leaders.
